'''Hriin River''' was a river on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Auratera/Legends|Auratera]]. The lifeblood of the town of [[Hriin/Legends|Hriin]], the river was used to power the town's generators and power the homes located there.<ref name="NoP" />
